verdict.rationale: Orama's hybrid-search docs say it can run full-text and vector search in one query and combine the results (orama-docs-5). The GitHub README and the Orama Cloud search docs also list hybrid search, and the embeddings plugin generates vectors at insert and search time to enable it (orama-gh-2, orama-docs-26, orama-docs-7). Missing for 10: details on how results are fused or weighted (e.g., tunable keyword/vector balance), independent or hands-on corroboration that the fused query works as claimed.
